title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Shared Vehicles - SharedVehicleStation
description: Place where you can both leave and pick up shared vehicles, composed of docks (edintvc:SharedVehicleStation, subclass of sosa:Platform, sosa:FeatureOfInterest and edint-infraestructura's Facility). Not the same entity as this candidate family's existing BikeSharingStation (edint-infraestructura) -- see standard-metadata.yaml.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SharedVehicleStation'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

infrastructureType.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of edint-infraestructura's InfrastructureType controlled vocabulary. Inherited from Facility.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Territorial unit the station belongs to. Inherited from Facility.

containsFacility.description: Relationship. Other Facility entities physically contained within this one. Inherited from Facility.

hasObservationPoint.description: Relationship. The ObservationPoint(s) associated with this station. Inherited from Facility.

hasRegisteredOwner.description: Relationship. The Organization that is the registered owner of this station. Inherited from Facility.

hasDock.description: Relationship. The Dock(s) that belong to this station (edintvc:hasDock).

operatedBy.description: Relationship. The Organization that operates this station (edintvc:operatedBy).

stationState.description: Property. The station's operational state, from the StationState controlled vocabulary (edintvc:stationState).

closureDate.description: Property. Date when the station ceases operation (edintvc:closureDate).

comissioningDate.description: Property. Date the station was certified and officially put into service (edintvc:comissioningDate -- property name copied verbatim from the source, including its apparent typo for 'commissioningDate').
